script_text: Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you right now. The cosmos is aligning in a way that demands your attention. Mars, your fiery ruling planet, is forming a tense square to Saturn in your 7th House of Partnerships, creating friction in your relationships. This aspect intensifies as Pluto oppositions your natal Sun, adding depth to your personal identity. In love, if you're single, Venus's trine to your natal Mars in the 5th House draws passionate encounters, while if you're taken, Mercury's square to your Moon may spark misunderstandings. Consider clarifying expectations to avoid unnecessary drama. Career-wise, the Sun's conjunction with Jupiter in your 10th House of Career signals a breakthrough opportunity and a potential bonus. Your hard work is about to be recognized by higher-ups. Avoid making major commitments under this Mars‑Saturn stress; instead, embrace the unexpected gift of a new networking connection. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
